learning_objective: 🎯 We will read a fun poem about riding a red bicycle and learn amazing new words!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The child in the poem has a lovely red bicycle. It has a nice soft seat to sit on.
When the child rides the bicycle the bell rings tring tring. It tells everyone to move out of the way!
The child uses their feet to push the pedals. This makes the beautiful red bicycle go very fast.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw Your Dream Bicycle
fun_activity.instructions: Take your crayons and draw a big bicycle on a piece of paper. Color it with your favorite colors and draw a shiny bell!

quick_recap: ⭐ The poem is about a beautiful red bicycle.
⭐ The bicycle bell makes a sweet tring tring sound.
⭐ We push the pedals to make the bicycle go fast.
